bodyRenderDistance.description: Max view-space depth (-view.z after cameraScale) at which individual body impostors (imp / impGlow / impNodeGlow body pass) are drawn. Farther bodies are skipped; hierarchical node glow can still show distant structure. Higher = bodies visible farther. Lower = only nearby bodies.

sphereSegments.description: Number of segments for sphere rendering

minDepth.description: Minimum and maximum depth for regions

maxDepth.description: Minimum and maximum depth for regions

nodeGlowThetaPx.description: impNodeGlow structure LOD: projected BH AABB size in screen pixels. Glow only for clusters smaller than this (accept band). Higher = glow larger/closer clusters. Lower = wait until clusters are tinier on screen.

nodeGlowActivateDist.description: impNodeGlow distance gate: view-space depth (-view.z after cameraScale). Hierarchical glow only when the node is farther than this. Higher = glow only farther away. Lower (0) = no near gate. Applies to both rectangles and circles.

nodeGlowRectMinDist.description: Square renderer near cutoff: view-space depth (-view.z after cameraScale), same units as nodeGlowActivateDist. Rectangles are drawn only farther than this. 0 = no extra near cutoff. Circles ignore it.

nodeGlowMinDepth.description: Rectangle glow floor: min post-propagate nodeDepth (height above furthest leaf). Leaves are 0, the root is tall. Rects draw for nodeGlowMinDepth <= nodeDepth <= nodeGlowMaxDepth.

nodeGlowMaxDepth.description: Rectangle glow ceiling: max post-propagate nodeDepth (height above furthest leaf). Rects draw for nodeGlowMinDepth <= nodeDepth <= this.

nodeGlowCircleMinDepth.description: Circle glow floor: min post-propagate nodeDepth. Circles draw for nodeGlowCircleMinDepth <= nodeDepth <= nodeGlowCircleMaxDepth.

nodeGlowCircleMaxDepth.description: Circle glow ceiling: max post-propagate nodeDepth. Circles draw for nodeGlowCircleMinDepth <= nodeDepth <= this.

nodeGlowDrawRect.description: Draw the rectangle node glow. Off skips that pass.

nodeGlowDrawCircle.description: Draw the circle node glow. Off skips that pass. A node inside both depth ranges is drawn twice.

nodeGlowIntensity.description: impNodeGlow brightness scale applied to hierarchical node-glow surface intensity (before Reinhard). Match body impGlow without crushing substructure. Lower = dimmer haze. Higher = brighter fills.

nodeGlowShape.description: Kept so older settings files still load. The draw booleans choose which passes run.

nodeGlowRectScale.description: impNodeGlow rect size relative to the normal square (longest side, or the projected union when project box is on). 1 = that size. 1.2 = 20% longer on each side. Circle mode ignores this.

nodeGlowProjectBox.description: impNodeGlow option 1: keep the longest-side square and grow it to cover any of the projected AABB that sticks past it, plus a 1px overlap. Off = the square only. The projected rect alone is smaller than the square when the long axis points at the camera, which opens gaps.

nodeGlowWriteDepth.description: impNodeGlow option 2: write gl_FragDepth at the box center. Off = the quad's interpolated depth. Depth mask stays off either way.

nodeGlowOneLevel.description: impNodeGlow option 3: draw only the coarsest node under theta on each branch. Off = every node in the size band (several generations).

nodeGlowMinFrac.description: impNodeGlow fine edge of the size band, as a fraction of nodeGlowThetaPx. 0.04 draws nodes down to 4% of theta. 0.5 keeps only the octave just under theta (can hide the glow if those nodes are past nodeGlowMaxDepth).
